name: Matthew Larsen
intro: I make campaigns, publications, packaging and digital content. My background is in commercial print, so I’m as comfortable preparing the final artwork as I am coming up with the idea.

campaigns.title: Nicola’s Fudge
description: A satirical campaign built around a fictional confectionery brand. I designed the identity, packaging, social graphics and print material, carrying the same visual language across the whole campaign.
I also developed, directed and edited the film, using Premiere Pro, After Effects and AI video tools.

campaigns.title: CAP RATES NOW
description: A campaign that had to work on a phone screen and the side of an 18-wheeler. I designed the identity, truck wrap, rally signage and social graphics, and worked on the video edits.
The truck was parked outside the Local Government New Zealand conference. Large type and a strong colour palette kept the message readable at a distance and in event footage.
